proposal.architecture_precedent: armv7l rows in ci.yml build_wheels (QEMU on ubuntu-24.04-arm); PR #247 copies this on ubuntu-latest.
proposal.build_backend: poetry-core with build_ext.py (setuptools Extension, C++11), no native library dependencies; REQUIRE_EXTENSION=1 forces extension.
proposal.contribution_rules: Conventional commits (commitlint), narrow scope, tests, CI passing; no CLA/DCO.
proposal.fork_guards: None in ci.yml (no github.repository conditions); release jobs rely on environment release and OIDC.
proposal.rationale: Park: PR https://github.com/Bluetooth-Devices/ulid-transform/pull/247 already adds the riscv64 QEMU rows to ci.yml following the merged armv7l precedent and is complete; it is awaiting maintainer (bdraco) review, not further development. A second patch would duplicate it. The package is portable C++11 with no riscv64 source work needed and the downstream RISE build already ships a tested wheel. Recommended next step: maintainer follow-up on #247; optionally polish its title/commit to conventional-commit form (commitlint) and add a riscv64 test command, only if the maintainer asks. An authorized force-develop can override.
proposal.release_coverage: Latest 2.2.9 (2026-05-25) PyPI wheels include macOS arm64, Linux x86_64/aarch64 and armv7l (manylinux/musllinux), Windows; no riscv64 (PyPI JSON read).
proposal.release_graph: push to main -> ci.yml release (python-semantic-release, env release) -> build_wheels (cibuildwheel v4.2.0) when released -> upload_pypi (trusted publishing).
proposal.risks: PR #247 riscv64 rows unexercised on PR (build_wheels skipped); QEMU build time; PR title not conventional ("Subject: [PATCH] ..."); maintainer latency.

sources.finding: Release path: semantic-release job "release" (environment release, OIDC) then build_wheels (cibuildwheel v4.2.0, REQUIRE_EXTENSION=1) gated on released==true, then upload_pypi via pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish. No repository fork guards (no if: github.repository condition). armv7l rows use ubuntu-24.04-arm + QEMU.
PR #247 CI run: all test/lint jobs passed; build_wheels and upload_pypi skipped because release outputs are not released on PRs, so the riscv64 rows were never exercised upstream.

Downstream RISE build-ulid-transform.yml uses reusable cibuildwheel builder; builds riscv64 wheels with REQUIRE_EXTENSION=1 and runs the pytest suite in cibuildwheel; publishes to pypi.riseproject.dev.
